curves.test_conditions: T_A = 25 °C, pulsed; reverse zener bias with cathode positive relative to anode. Fig. 2 shows the BZT52C20 curve and a P_D = 500 mW family boundary.

datasheet_identity.title: BZT52C2V0 THRU BZT52C75 SURFACE MOUNT ZENER DIODES

extraction_notes: The BZT52C20 table row specifies V_Z = 19.00 V minimum, 20.0 V nominal, and 21.00 V maximum at I_ZT = 5 mA, T_A = 25 °C. The nominal reverse zener voltage and test current are represented as the typical breakdown pair; this is not inferred from the maximum reverse-voltage rating.

The Fig. 2 points are manual digitizations of visible points on the curve explicitly labeled 20. Voltage and current are reported as positive reverse-bias magnitudes while polarity is stated in the curve conditions; the current axis is logarithmic.
The 0.9 V forward-voltage entry is in the Maximum Ratings table and is therefore encoded as a maximum bound, not a typical value.

The datasheet provides no numeric capacitance value or reverse-recovery specification for BZT52C20. The page 3 capacitance plots are family-level curves with multiple bias conditions, so no target-specific capacitance value was asserted.
omission_reason: No numeric target-specific capacitance or reverse-recovery value is stated; the family-level capacitance plots were not converted into a single BZT52C20 spec without a directly attributable plotted point.
